Royal Association Athlétique Louviéroise La Louvière is a Belgian professional football club based in La Louvière, in the province of Hainaut. The club was founded in 2009. It competes in the Belgian Pro League, the top tier of Belgian football, after being promoted from the Challenger Pro League in 2025.
